result.summary: Found 1 visually broken element: the header's top-right action button appears blank with its icon/avatar missing. Other partially visible items are intentional scroll/viewport cut-offs and were not reported.

issues.description: Top-right circular button in the header appears empty/blank, showing only a light grey circle with a small red dot and no visible icon or avatar image inside it.
issues.suggestion: Restore the missing icon or avatar image inside the button, ensure the asset loads correctly, and provide a visible fallback/placeholder and accessible label so the control is identifiable.
